The accounting staff works on this floor, right?
A. Yes, there are offices down the hall.
B. That's not my invoice.
C. A lot of renovation work.

会计部门就在这一层，对吗？
A. 是的，走廊尽头有办公室。
B. 这不是我的发票。
C. 很多翻修工作。

choices: Yes, there are offices down the hall.
